findings.title: Label may overlap vanilla's trade arrow on ticked pawn rows (older issue, not from this build)
findings.detail: Vanilla draws TradeArrow centred in the 90px box when CountToTransfer != 0. The label starts 17px left of the middle, so 'entered' may overlap the arrow. This was already true at the old 80px width. If it shows up in a screenshot, start the label after the arrow (rect.center.x + TradeArrow.width/2) rather than at +28. Not confirmed: the arrow texture width and whether ticked rows always have a nonzero count were not checked.
